teaser: A technical user believed Claude read his email only when asked; an unrelated chat listed his inbox.
core_idea: A technical user expected Claude to read his email only in the one conversation where he asked, and his daily forum task never to touch it. In an unrelated chat, asked about his inbox, Claude listed it: a connected connector is available in every conversation and to scheduled tasks. The authority was granted at the connection, not the prompt. With private data, untrusted content and a way to send, the setup has the lethal trifecta. RiskMandate measures this gap between mandate and reach and closes it with enforced policy.
